senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. Nöld. Mand. Gr. p. 147) horse.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 26b:2">Succ. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>שינת הס׳</he> the (short) sleep of the horse, v. <cite ref="N01333"><he>נִשְׁמָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:9:3">Cant. R. to VIII, 9</cite> <he>אם ראית ס׳ פרסי וכ׳</he> when thou seest the Persian horse (Parthian cavalry) tied &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 2:5">Snh. II, 5</cite> <he>על סוּסוֹ</he> on the king’s horse; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 95">Gen. R. s. 95</cite>, end <he>הס׳ לקבלי</he> (read: <he>לקבלך</he>) the horse is before thee (has been surrendered), v. <cite ref="B00313"><he>בּוּצְלָא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>סוּסִים</he>, <he>סוּסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21b:17">Ib. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ הבטלנין</he>, v. <cite ref="B00520"><he>בַּטְלָן</he></cite>; a. fr.—
Cant. R. to I, 9 ס׳ נקבות mares.—Fem. סוּסָה.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 42:7">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLII</cite>; <cite ref="O00372"><he>סוּסְיָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>סוּסְיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23:14">Ex. R. s. 23</cite>, end <he>ס׳ נקבות</he>, v. supra.
